name: 王者归来
english_description: A member of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine family (see nitan170911, nitan6, hhsj, xfbhh, nt1, nt6). Core daemons (master.lpc, logind.lpc, securityd.lpc, chinesed.lpc) share the family's overall shape but have diverged substantially in content from every sibling checked (hundreds to thousands of differing lines even after whitespace normalization) -- a real independent branch, not a duplicate. New characters undergo the same Pangu creation-myth 'birth ceremony' as hhsj/nt6 (choose a personality, wash attributes in the Valley of Life, land in the Ancient Village).
